instruction: Create a 2-hour Thunderbird Calendar event titled `Doctor appointment` for tomorrow at 9:00 AM. To help prepare for the appointment, use Immersive Reader to read the appointment-preparation article, then add a note to the event description stating, in the article's exact wording, which medicines and related health products should be included when completing paperwork at home.
gt_steps: Open the appointment-preparation AP News article in Microsoft Edge.
Find the article's advice about which medicines and related health products to include when filling out paperwork at home.
Enable the `Home` calendar if it is disabled.
Determine tomorrow's date from the Windows system date.
Create a new calendar event for tomorrow at `9:00 AM`.
Set the event duration to `2 hours`.
Set the event title to `Doctor appointment`.
Enter `Include both prescription and over-the-counter medicines, pills or creams — and don’t forget vitamins and supplements.` in the event description.

rules.title: Doctor appointment
body_points: Include both prescription and over-the-counter medicines, pills or creams — and don’t forget vitamins and supplements.
